identitySignals: SPG's own website (spgtherapy.com) shows the legal/footer name 'The Speech Pathology Group' and describes a multidisciplinary therapy provider; OUSD's earlier master contract (Legistar File 22-2317) is with 'Speech Pathology Group, Walnut Creek, CA' for special education services for students with an IEP, matching the agenda's 'SPG Therapy & Education, Walnut Creek, CA' and Special Education Department
SPG's website says it is a California-based, State Certified Nonpublic Agency (NPA), matching OUSD's 'Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School, Agency Master Contract' titles
SPG's FAQ says it operates a Walnut Creek clinic, matching the agenda location
research.notes: Agenda gives Walnut Creek, CA; SPG's website lists a Concord, CA headquarters address and also a Walnut Creek clinic. The legal name 'The Speech Pathology Group' is from the site footer; no CA Secretary of State entity number, EIN, or SAM UEI was verified, and orgType was not confirmed from a registry so it is left null.

profile.address: 1320 Willow Pass Rd, Suite 700 | Concord, CA 94520
profile.summary: SPG Therapy & Education is a California-based provider of therapy and education services for children and adults, including speech-language pathology, occupational therapy, physical therapy, behavior intervention, school psychology and mental health services. It offers clinic-based and school-based services and describes itself as a State Certified Nonpublic Agency that has operated since 1989.

review.notes: SPG (The Speech Pathology Group) states it is a State Certified Nonpublic Agency with a Walnut Creek clinic, matching the agenda's Walnut Creek location and the NPA master-contract titles. Contact details, services and legal name are confirmed on cited pages; the 1989 date appears on the school-based page (as California roots since 1989); I could not independently re-check the Legistar 22-2317 claim because my search budget was exhausted.
